decisions.scenario: Booking a moderately priced restaurant in central Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can you help me find somewhere to eat in the centre?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Sure. Is there a particular type of food you'd like?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I don't mind the type of food, but I'd like a moderately priced restaurant.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yippee Noodle Bar matches your requirements. Would you like me to make a reservation?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, please. There are five of us for Monday at 19:45.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The booking was successful. The table will be held for 15 minutes. Your reference number is SOPGGCUP.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you for your help.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're very welcome.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great service. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a great day.

decisions.scenario: Checking a Monday train from Cambridge to Norwich

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for a train from Cambridge on Monday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Where would you like to go?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: My destination is Norwich. I'd like to leave after 15:15.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Will you be travelling alone?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes. I only need one ticket.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR9460 leaves Cambridge on Monday at 15:36. Would you like to reserve a seat?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, I just need the price and arrival time.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The price is £17.60, and the journey takes 79 minutes.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks. I don't need a reservation.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The train arrives in Norwich at 16:55. If you need nothing else, goodbye.
